info.title: Axiom Protocol Backend
info.description: Axiom Protocol backend HTTP/WS surface: chat (SSE), agents, events, orchestrator, skills, archive, MCP (streamable-HTTP), WebSocket stream. SSE/WS frame specs and the key-tier model are documented via x-* extensions (x-sse-events, x-websocket/x-ws-events, securityScheme descriptions).

serverKey.name: x-api-key
serverKey.description: Server key (AXIOM_API_KEY). Full access; also accepted by /v1/stream via ?token=. SAME header as clientKey — the key VALUE distinguishes the tier.

clientKey.name: x-api-key
clientKey.description: Browser key (AXIOM_CLIENT_API_KEY). SAME header as serverKey; only CLIENT_ALLOWED_ROUTES are reachable (everything else → 403 CLIENT_PATH_DENIED).

indexerKey.name: x-indexer-key
indexerKey.description: Indexer key (AXIOM_INDEXER_API_KEY). Required IN ADDITION to x-api-key for POST /v1/events.

wsToken.name: token
wsToken.description: Server or client key passed as ?token= on the /v1/stream WebSocket upgrade (fail-closed 401).

code.description: Stable error codes. HTTP_<status> is a dynamic family.

requestId.description: Echo of the x-request-id header (absent on a few legacy routes)

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes. HTTP_<status> is a dynamic family.

url.description: Target URL (bare hosts are normalized to https://). SSRF-guarded: http(s) only, private/loopback hosts rejected. Required for lookup/confirm/closest.

trust_mode.description: Present only on the ?model= passthrough branch (mapped from router verifiability)

services.description: No ?model: deterministic pseudo-address per router model. With ?model: real provider records (address/latency/pricing/TEE) with model + trust_mode.

messages.description: OpenAI chat message params (role + content/tool_calls), incl. the assistant reply

wallet.description: Lowercased wallet address that keyed the thread

totalMinted.description: Distinct agent token IDs minted on-chain (full-range log scan)

latestTokenId.description: Highest minted token ID (null when registry is empty)

TransferResponse.description: Two-step ownership transfer: challenge stage (signed ownership challenge) or final stage (full access proof)

results.description: Map of agent token ID → metrics

contract.description: Source contract of the timelock views

currentAddress.description: Reserved for the current holder view; always null today

pendingAddress.description: Proposed rotation target (null = idle / zero address)

executableAt.description: Unix seconds when execute() unlocks (null = idle, or view absent e.g. teeSigner)

ArchiveResult.description: Intent-shaped archive result: lookup {url,count,snapshots,note?}, confirm {archived,snapshot}, account {handle,count,snapshots}, closest {url,snapshot}. `cached: true` on TTL hits.

SkillResult.description: Skill-specific result object (bigint fields serialized as strings). See the skill's component schema for request shape.

ChatStreamTerminalFrame.description: Router terminal chunk: usage + x_0g_trace with empty choices, right before [DONE]

trace.description: Terminal chunk usage ∪ x_0g_trace ∪ providerHeader (from the upstream x-provider header, when present)

ChatStreamErrorFrame.description: Mid-stream failure (only after headers were already flushed)

anyOf.description: complete: full TickResult payload spread onto the frame
